verdict.rationale: Name.com's docs list official SDKs for TypeScript, Go and PHP on a dedicated SDK index page. It describes them as typed clients that map directly to the Core API reference, and the sandbox environment lets you run integration tests against them. Evidence beyond that is thin. Missing for 10: a Python SDK (only "coming soon"), per-SDK installation and usage documentation, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the SDKs work as described.
